items.name: Veil-Thread Bracelet
items.lore: A thread from the veil between worlds. It's very hard to see.

items.name: Otherworld Apple Charm
items.lore: An apple from beyond the veil, cast in gold. Don't eat it. It's gold.

items.name: Seven-Year Ring
items.lore: Rian's ring. It fit him when he was ten.

items.name: Wisp-Light Cloak
items.lore: It glimmers faintly, like a veil wisp at the edge of sight.

items.name: Oak-Heart Acorn
items.lore: A golden acorn from the heart of a sacred grove. It's warm, like something sleeping.

items.name: Siog Thief's Ring
items.lore: The siog steal everything that isn't nailed down. This ring was stolen eleven times.

items.name: Renegade Druid Torc
items.lore: A druid's torc, from a druid who forgot what druids are for.

items.name: Grove-Keeper's Mantle
items.lore: Green and brown, the colours of a grove that lives.
